name.title: Name
name.description: Name of the scenario for further information.

desc.title: Description
desc.description: Description of the scenario for documentation purposes.

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: Array of tags that have been applied to the document.

cat.title: Tax Categories
cat.description:
Optional list of tax category codes that acts as a filter. When set, at least
one of the specified categories must be present in the document's line taxes
for the scenario to match.

ext_key.title: Extension Key
ext_key.description: Extension key that must be present in the document.

ext_code.title: Extension Code
ext_code.description:
Extension code that, alongside the key, must be present for a match. Cannot be
used without the extension key. The value will be copied to the note code if
needed.

note.title: Note
note.description: A note to be added to the document if the scenario is applied.

codes.title: Codes
codes.description: Additional codes for regime specific situations.

ext.title: Extensions
ext.description:
Tax extensions that should be applied to the document in the appropriate "tax"
context.

tax.Scenario.description: Scenario is used to describe a tax scenario of a document based on the combination of document type and tag used.
